revision_reason: R01 was blocked because its runbook was not directly executable, its execution chain was not hash-bound, it mislabeled unobserved MBB as effective, and it overclaimed K=1 contention and BBM switching that the event ledger did not exercise.
objective: Review a narrow immutable formal smoke proving the governed leo_sim_v2 endpoint-to-satellite multi-satellite data path can execute without any legacy Gateway fallback.
context: R02 validates direct TrafficEndpoint access, arrived control information, non-oracle hop routing, actual data ISL service, GE evaluation on service paths, natural completion and data/control conservation.
K=1 contention, BBM switching, MBB switching, outage occurrence, DDQN and performance effects are separate matrix gates and are not claimed by this smoke.
deliverables: Three independent review receipts binding every R02 experiment artifact
cannot_claim: This smoke does not prove K=1 contention, BBM or MBB switching, outage occurrence, DDQN, speedup, algorithm superiority, operator-calibrated physics, or VM success before the authorized run ends naturally.
acceptance: The generated runbook contains complete project-relative authorization and explicit leo_sim_v2 remote-launch commands.
The manifest and authorization bind the leo_sim package and the authorization/deployment/remote-launch file hashes, exact config, trace/input identity and acceptance contract.

Formal eligibility requires natural end, valid receipt, conservation, at least one delivery, at least one multi-satellite delivery, positive data ISL occupancy, arrived control traffic, effective control plane and effective GE evaluation.
The runtime invokes CODE.leo_sim only and cannot silently fall back to the legacy Gateway path.
